say:0:1012719501:0.text: Even if you wanted to turn back, it's too late for you now!
say:0:1012719501:0.source_cn: 事到如今，就算你想要回头，也为时已晚。
say:0:1012719501:0.male: Even if you wanted to turn back, it's too late for you now!
say:0:1012719501:0.female: Even if you wanted to turn back, it's too late for you now!

say:1:1012719502:0.text: A wise man always has a way out when one is needed!
say:1:1012719502:0.source_cn: 别得意的太早！聪明人懂得留有后路！
say:1:1012719502:0.male: A wise man always has a way out when one is needed!
say:1:1012719502:0.female: A wise man always has a way out when one is needed!
